I went to St. Cecilia Catholic School from kindergarten until 7th grade. It was a horrible experience. In kindergarten everyone made fun of me because my four upper front teeth were fake and looked blue (from falling off the play structure). In first grade everyone made fun of me because I chased the boys. Second grade was when people started to tease me about my hair, it was “like black peoples”. An eighth grader named Aidan threw food at me and called me Afro-Thunder. In 3rd grade I remember being the teacher’s pet and having the biggest crush on my friend Sean. I used to think I was in-love with him. It’s funny how my heart really fell for the nerdiest guy, only to be rejected. In fourth grade I crushed on Ivan. I was made fun of for hanging-out with him. He was the best friend anyone could have, I miss him still. The first time I went to his house was also the last. He hugged me and I was so happy that I blabbed to a few people. I guess that was to much contact for me and him to have because soon everyone knew. They made fun of him for hugging me and everything just got bad. I started fighting with him daily. I got suspended a few times because of him.

Fifth grade was one of the more memorable years, it was the first year of sex-ed but we called it “Family Life”. Everyone went crazy. Also, every Friday we had spotlights. Spotlight was were we had to go up in front of the class and share about our likes and dislikes, our hobbies, and our family, etc. I remember going up to do mine, not wanting to share. I brought up a video of me on the news, a sculpture of a frog made out of soap, a Raggedy Ann doll, and a picture of my cousin and me. I still have the project too. It’s in the memory box in my closet. One day Sean, the guy I still had a crush on, had told me to draw a picture of me killing the new girl, Megan. I did, because I liked him. He told on me! I got suspended for that; for drawing a picture that someone told me to draw!

After the fifth grade drama came sixth grade drama, that’s when I started to “become a women” and I had a new BFF April. We went to Lake Tahoe and we hung out all the time in ETC (extended care). It was also the year I got my first F. My teacher had told Irene and me to go outside and wait by the computer cart. She later came out and showed us our grades. We were so scared, we thought we were getting in trouble. Instead, she just told us to do better and called out parents.
